name: queue-clear-5m
label: Queue Clear 5m
desc: Only quotes books whose queue is likely to clear inside five minutes.
thesis: A quote stuck behind a slow queue is dead capital; refusing those books should lift fill quality per order.
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 8 stop exits, the same count as Balanced Mid, and a -$0.80 loss where the book moved right after the fill; five minutes let a slow queue turn into a bad one.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 3-minute window excludes books whose queue velocity is uncertain, trading quote count for quality per quote.

name: balanced-mid
label: Balanced Mid
desc: The middle preset: proportional volatility tracking without the aggressive clamp.
thesis: A 2-4c band trades some edge for reach, which should merge more pairs than the wide arms.
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: two early stops at minute 194 (-$0.70) and 205 (-$0.40) landed in the same volatile cluster that hit every arm; the 2-4c offset gave up before the pair completed.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 6c deadband holds the resting quote through the volatile window instead of cancelling and re-entering at a worse price.

name: loose-baseline
label: Loose Baseline
profile: shipped baseline: dynamic 0.50x, 1-20c, 15c window, no widen snap-back
desc: Control. The shipped loose baseline with nothing changed; every other arm is read against it.
thesis: The shipped defaults are the reference: any arm must beat this to earn a change.
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 11 stop exits on 40 trades -- the most filled orders in the run -- clustered between minute 194 and 268, the volatile print every arm met; this arm sets no stop mode in its env, so 5c is the shipped default threshold, not an active stop.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the shipped 3c deadband requotes into the volatile cluster and re-enters lower; 6c holds queue position and only re-prices on a real move.

name: prudent-hybrid
label: Prudent Hybrid
desc: The hybrid preset between conservative and balanced, with the preset's 4c clamp lifted to 6c so it is not the same arm as balanced.
thesis: A 0.60x multiplier is the compromise: enough cushion for swings, close enough to fill.
worst_catalyst: Gap trade at minute 193.8: cumulative $1.19 to $0.49
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 7 stops, worst single loss -$0.70, Sharpe 9.52 and profit factor 7.36 -- the best risk-adjusted arm; its one structural exposure is the cluster every arm met.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: no stop change is warranted; a 6c deadband is the cheapest way to turn that recurring cluster stop into a hold.

name: static-floor-2c
label: Static Floor 2c
desc: Volatility tracking switched off; every quote rests a flat 2c under the mid.
thesis: The dynamic offset is mostly noise; a fixed 2c floor should quote more consistently for less machinery.
worst_catalyst: One close of -$2.28 at minute 304.8, the run's largest
worst_catalyst_desc: 6.4 h snapshot: 66 fills on 173 quotes (38.2% fill rate) and one close of -$2.28, the run's largest and about 9% worse than the next-worst -$2.10; a flat 2c offset prices a calm and a volatile book identically.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: the orphan formed because the resting quote was priced for a calm book during a volatile print; a volatility-tracking offset widens exactly then.
